about_text:
WEM Labeler v1.7 (WPF)

Label missing WEM audio files
Live preview via vgmstream

Config: config.json, UI supports Chinese/English

"Extract Audio" tab (reads game files directly, no odradek.exe, no per-object resource JSON):
  0. Read game resources (chain + wem_index.json + .bnk)
  Export WEM audio (~10GB)
  2. Generate TXTP with wwiser
  3. Enrich the audio mapping (txtp/WEM/bank)
  4. Export audio from mapping
  Analyze unused WEM / Rebuild txtp index / Export by Event ID

Labeling tab:
  "Play this WEM audio" (in File Info) loads this WEM into the player; every txtp under "Source Links" has an "Open" (left-click: Notepad, right-click: default program) and a "Play" button that loads that txtp into the player
  The player (Play/Resume + Stop + waveform) only ever plays what is loaded into it - seeking or pressing Space never swaps the source behind your back
  "Import Labels..." back-fills labels from exported audio file names (coord_WemID_label.wav); non-matching files are ignored

Shortcuts:
  Up/Down  previous/next file (auto-save)
  Space    play/stop what is loaded in the player
  Ctrl+T   play the txtp this WEM belongs to
  Ctrl+S   save current label
  Enter    save while focused in the label box
